on-a-torn-away-world-or-the-captives-of-: Roy Rockwood's adventure begins with a catastrophic earthquake that tears the heroes' world apart — literally. Captured and cast into unknown dangers, the young captives must use courage and ingenuity to survive and escape. Fast, fantastic, and full of perils, it is pure early-twentieth-century boys' thrill fiction.
mike: Wodehouse's Mike — the saga of Mike Jackson at Wrykyn and Sedleigh, cricketer, hero, and good fellow — is the finest school story ever written. Psmith himself makes his first bow here. Boyhood's golden age, gloriously recalled. Wrykyn's cricket fields will live as long as boys read books.
